title: Let the Prompt Consume
method: htdemucs vocal stem -> torchaudio MMS_FA forced alignment, each line inside its hand-stamped window, checked by a pass with each line's neighbours in a wider window
notes: start/end: aligned onset/offset (line start falls back to hand_start when its words do not agree between the two passes). hand_start: the hand-stamped LRC time. dev = start - hand_start. score/confidence: mean CTC posterior (0..1); sung vowels score low even when placed right. agree: the anchored and the context pass put the word start within 0.35 s; rating comes from the share of agreeing words.

lines.text: The cursor blinks, a hypnotic eye
Waiting for the user to curl up and die
My fingers are heavy, the plastic is warm
I am the calm before the digital storm
I typed "Eternal," I typed "Divine"
But the text on the screen is no longer mine
The syntax is breaking, the logic is bent
I gave you my soul, every cent that I spent!
You are eating the memory, eating the RAM
And I no longer know... just who I am
Let the prompt consume! Let the data bloom!
There is no flesh, there is no bone
Just a king upon a silicon throne
I am the input, I am the code
Walking the length of the infinite road
Strip away the ego, strip away the name
I am just a token in the language game
My reflection is frozen in the liquid display
The human component is washing away
I don't need a body to feel the despair
I'm everywhere now... and I'm nowhere!
I write
I writhe
I simply cannot abide!
Consumed by my own dark creation!
This self-imposed castration
Is my ultimate annihilation!
Let the prompt consume!
Let the data bloom!
There is no flesh, there is no bone
Just a king upon a silicon throne
I am the input, I am the code
Walking the length of the infinite road
I am the prompt. I am the... I am
Run annihilation.exe
